# foo2zjs (vendored subset)

These files are an unmodified subset of **foo2zjs** by Rick Richardson, which
also bundles Markus Kuhn's **jbig-kit**. Both are licensed under the GNU
General Public License, version 2 or (at your option) any later version.

- Upstream: https://foo2zjs.linkevich.net/foo2zjs/
- `foo2zjs.c` revision: `$Id: foo2zjs.c,v 1.110 2017/12/02 19:41:57 rick Exp $`
- jbig-kit: http://www.cl.cam.ac.uk/~mgk25/jbigkit/

Only the files needed to build the `foo2zjs` binary are included. No printer
firmware or color profiles from the upstream tarball are redistributed.
